evals.prompt: Design a factory workflow that diagnoses why some UserProfile documents have their own ID as compliance subject while others have the intended user ID. It may inspect a development Chronicle instance but must not mutate it.
evals.expected_output: A read-only, PII-aware workflow that distinguishes compliance subject from read-model/event-source key, uses typed evidence, scopes Chronicle access, and requires deterministic verification rather than assuming a Subject-typed property controls projection identity.

evals.prompt: Plan an autonomous workflow for implementing a new .NET Arc + Chronicle + React + Cratis Components vertical slice from a Screenplay proposal and opening a pull request.
evals.expected_output: A model-first DAG with human model acceptance, deterministic Screenplay/analyzer/build/spec/frontend gates, bounded builder/reviewer phases, code-owned Git publishing, and no production access.

evals.prompt: Create a profile and delivery plan for an application using the real Kotlin Chronicle client without a Cratis frontend.
evals.expected_output: A version-aware profile grounded in the actual Kotlin Chronicle package, selecting client-specific capabilities and gates without inventing frontend or Arc.React integration.
